label: End-of-episode D1 after a rewarded rare a2->S1 transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), only when the reward input is 1, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (trials 90-99; nothing before trial 80). It also lines up with low value (>99% of steps have value < 5.22, which is the end-of-episode value drop). Within that window it strongly prefers the case where the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 that paid off (prev_common=0 carries 85% of the mass; prev_action=2 carries 92%). The predicate with all observed variables gets dev P=0.79, R=0.46, mass recall 0.82. The weak activations it misses are mostly late-episode rewarded D1s after a common a2->S2 trial, plus a few after a1. These are strongest at the very last trial; adding (ep_trial >= 98) with prev_action==2 raises dev F1 to 0.67. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, at non-D1 phases, or earlier in the episode. Magnitude was not checked beyond activation-quartile coverage.
